adjudication.rationale: In packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts, when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT are set, the function performs a plain fetch(...) to the external sync endpoint (POST with URLSearchParams) without any AbortController-based timeout, retry/backoff, or failure isolation. Since multiple integrations were rewired to use refreshOAuthTokens for token refresh, an unresponsive/slow sync endpoint can stall or fail those refresh paths broadly. This is a reliability/architecture concern evident from the diff, not a strictly verifiable functional defect in isolation.
